title: famille.interop.v0
talk: Siblings keep their own repo. They share the four keys (quelle, temoin, epsilon, horizon). FAMILLE does not vendor their code. A card is JSON. A missing card keeps MODE classique.

faces.note: 2026-09-04: GET /juge on the cited host still HTML 404. Worker locks are unit-tested. Carl deploys via acorn-juge/DEPLOY.md. Not a second grok.me slug.

nodes.talks: publishes the card schema and interop table; consumes, does not sign

nodes.asks: until when the seal hypothesis holds
nodes.note: On the card, horizon is a calendar day. UFHY1 is a suite name, never a date.
Transfer = destroy here / born there. Do not fork a measure.

nodes.asks: must physics be re-measured before which day
nodes.note: Physics is not crypto. Expired is not false. Re-measure.
MODE is the collapse of the four cards, not a fifth card.

nodes.asks: through which channel / which loopholes stay open
did money move, on which named rail
nodes.note: Receipt, not a mint. No quantum coin.

nodes.asks: does this file still match the card that sealed it
nodes.talks: reads optional quelle/horizon cards; never signs; mobile v0 is digest-only

nodes.asks: can the proof fit in a pocket
did every passage name the same SHA-256
can a proof be withdrawn without erasing history

nodes.talks: display canal; same refusal as the local path; not a second grok.me
merge guardian; if one listed attack passes, the FAMILLE label is broken

nodes.asks: which claims are admitted, not theorems
nodes.talks: EasyCrypt obligations. Do not write formally verified.
